title: Brave Words at the Table
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
At dinner with the king one night,
Queen Esther spoke out clear:
"Please save my people and save me,
a wicked plan is near."

[Chorus]
Be brave and tell the truth, dear one,
though it is hard to do;
Like Esther, speak up, brave and kind,
and God will stand with you.

[Verse 2]
"Who did this?" asked the king. She said,
"It's Haman." Right away
the king stopped Haman's wicked plan,
and all were safe that day.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my little one,
the day is at its end;
Be brave and true like Esther was,
and God is near, your friend.

[Chorus]
mood: Steady music. A firm, even step moves under the voice, like a brave girl walking up to the king's table with her heart beating calm and sure. The first two verses keep that quiet courage moving forward, never rushed and never hidden. By the last verse the step softens into a slow rock, lower and slower, as the truth is told and the room grows safe and still.
